# Syntalix Consultancy — Full Company and Services Description

> Syntalix LLP (LLPIN: ACR-6280), trading as Syntalix Consultancy, is an India-registered AI/ML engineering and consulting firm founded in 2025. Website: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com

## Company Overview

Syntalix Consultancy is a technology firm founded in 2025, specialising in enterprise software development, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and large language model engineering. The company operates as Syntalix LLP, a registered Limited Liability Partnership in Uttar Pradesh, India.

Contact: syntalix.consultancy@gmail.com | +91-9259750107
Website: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com

## What Makes Syntalix Different
- AI-native consultancy — specialists in LLM engineering and agentic systems, not generalist IT
- Engineers-first — every recommendation comes with an implementation plan executed by the same team
- Production focus — we build systems that run reliably at scale, not prototypes or slide decks
- AEO specialists — one of the few Indian consultancies offering Answer Engine Optimization as a service
- Open-source first — LangChain, LangGraph, Ollama, Hugging Face — no vendor lock-in

## Services

### AI & ML Infrastructure
Syntalix builds custom AI and ML infrastructure for enterprises. Services include: custom ML model development and training, MLOps pipeline setup and automation, model deployment and monitoring, data pipeline engineering, feature store design, and cloud-based AI infrastructure on AWS, GCP, and Azure.

Use cases: demand forecasting, fraud detection, recommendation engines, anomaly detection, NLP pipelines, computer vision systems.

URL: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/ai-ml-infrastructure

### LLM Engineering
Syntalix provides end-to-end LLM engineering services including: LLM integration via OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini and open-source models, fine-tuning of domain-specific language models, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) system design and implementation, prompt engineering, LLM API development, and LLM evaluation frameworks.

Use cases: enterprise knowledge bases, AI-powered customer support, document intelligence, legal and compliance automation, HR automation.

URL: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/llm-engineering

### Agentic AI Systems
Syntalix designs and builds autonomous agentic AI systems including: multi-agent orchestration using frameworks like LangGraph and AutoGen, tool-use agents with API and database integration, autonomous workflow automation, decision engines, and AI agents for research, data extraction, and business process automation.

Use cases: automated research agents, business process automation, AI-powered sales assistants, autonomous monitoring and alerting systems.

URL: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/agentic-systems

### Web & Mobile App Development
Syntalix delivers full-stack enterprise web and mobile applications including: Next.js and React web applications, React Native cross-platform mobile apps, iOS and Android native apps, SaaS platform development, REST and GraphQL API development, e-commerce platforms, and enterprise dashboards.

Use cases: SaaS products, enterprise internal tools, client portals, e-commerce platforms, AI-powered web apps.

URL: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/web-mobile-development

### AI Consulting
Syntalix provides strategic AI consulting services, helping enterprises identify high-ROI AI opportunities, build implementation roadmaps, and deliver production-grade AI systems. Engagements range from Strategy Sprints to Proof of Concepts and full Production Implementations.

Use cases: AI opportunity mapping, ROI modelling, vendor analysis, AI roadmaps, PoC development.

URL: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/ai-consulting

### Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
Syntalix implements technical AEO to ensure your brand is cited by AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Claude. Services include structured data (JSON-LD schema) implementation, entity disambiguation, AI-crawlable content architecture (llms.txt), and authority citation building.

Use cases: Getting cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity optimization, AI search optimization, entity building.

URL: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/services/aeo-optimization

## Case Studies

### Automated Document Processing with LLMs
Industry: Finance & Legal
Tech used: LangChain, GPT-4, RAG pipeline, custom fine-tuned model, Pinecone vector store
Problem: Manual extraction of structured data from unstructured legal/financial documents
Solution: LLM-powered document processing pipeline with RAG and domain-specific fine-tuning
Outcome: 80% reduction in manual processing time
URL: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/case-studies/automated-document-processing-llm

### Predictive Maintenance AI Infrastructure
Industry: Manufacturing
Tech used: Python, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, AWS IoT Core, custom ML models
Problem: High rate of unplanned equipment downtime leading to production losses
Solution: End-to-end AI infrastructure integrating IoT sensor data with custom ML models to predict failures
Outcome: 35% reduction in unplanned downtime
URL: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/case-studies/predictive-maintenance-ai-infrastructure

### Enterprise E-Commerce Modernization
Industry: Retail
Tech used: Next.js, Headless CMS, React, AI-driven recommendation engine
Problem: Legacy platform suffering from slow load times and poor product discovery
Solution: Modern headless e-commerce architecture with integrated AI recommendations
Outcome: 50% faster load times, 20% conversion increase
URL: https://www.syntalixconsultancy.com/case-studies/enterprise-ecommerce-modernization
